subject: Prep: Meridian Labs tenant onboarding & API key plan
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Desai <aisha.desai@meridianlabs.com>, Meridian Labs IT <it@meridianlabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Prep: Meridian Labs tenant onboarding & API key plan

Hi Aisha / Meridian IT team,

Great to meet you last week — excited to get Meridian Labs into Redwood. To make the first 72 hours smooth, I sketched a minimal-onboarding plan (attached) with the items we usually need to unblock testing and initial integration:

- Workspace + project creation (one project per environment: dev/stage/prod)
- Admin user list + emails for seed invites
- KMS/HSM key approval (if you want customer-managed keys)
- API key seeding + ephemeral service-account token flow
- Role matrix: admin, billing, infra, app-integration

Can you confirm: who should be the initial admin? Also let me know if Meridian requires an internal ticket for IAM changes (we can sync with your IT contact).

I've attached an onboarding schedule and a lightweight API-key checklist. If it helps, Monica can run the admin-invite sprint next Tuesday (we have a short window for seeding keys before the pilot traffic).

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm admin and any KMS constraints by EOD Monday
2) We (Redwood) send pre-seed invites and a short template for service accounts
3) Meridian IT confirms network allowlist for our ingestion endpoints (I'll include the IP range in a follow-up)

Attachments: meridian-onboard-schedule.xlsx (plan, timeline) | redwood-api-keying-checklist.pdf (how we seed + rotate)

Thanks,
Connor O'Brien
Customer Implementation Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Desai <aisha.desai@meridianlabs.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Meridian Labs IT <it@meridianlabs.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prep: Meridian Labs tenant onboarding & API key plan

Connor — thanks for the plan and the attachments. Quick answers from our side:

- Initial admin: I'll be the admin during the pilot (aisha.desai@meridianlabs.com). I will hand over to our Platform Lead once we've validated the flow.
- KMS: We prefer customer-managed keys in KMS-AWS (account xxxxx). Need your KMS URI format and Redwoods' support window for HSM-backed keys.
- Allowlist: Our networking team needs the IP ranges and a short justification for each endpoint.

Meridian IT (cc) — can you confirm the expected SLA for issuing an internal IAM ticket? We typically need a 24–48 hour window.

Also, do you seed a test API key scoped to read-only for the first week? That would help our QA team.

Aisha Desai
Director of AI Integrations
Meridian Labs

From: Meridian Labs IT <it@meridianlabs.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Aisha Desai <aisha.desai@meridianlabs.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prep: Meridian Labs tenant onboarding & API key plan

Connor / Monica,

We can issue an IAM ticket within 48 hours. For KMS/CMK requests we need: account number, key alias, and an anticipated usage profile (low/medium/high). We also need the outbound IP ranges for your callback/webhook endpoints so our security team can add them to the firewall.

We are fine with a read-only test API key for QA — please mark any seeded keys explicitly in the subject or description.

Regards,
Rahul Kumar
Infrastructure Engineer
Meridian Labs IT

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Desai <aisha.desai@meridianlabs.com>, Meridian Labs IT <it@meridianlabs.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Prep: Meridian Labs tenant onboarding & API key plan

Thanks for the fast replies — looping in Ben to coordinate the actual seeding. Connor and I can run the admin-invite sprint on Tuesday (2028-07-24) at 10:00 PT if that works for Meridian.

Ben — action items for us to prepare:
- Produce a 'seed manifest' CSV with the initial admin and two service accounts (names + emails + intended scopes)
- Create a read-only test key for QA and a separate test service account token
- Produce KMS URI example and the expected key alias format for Meridian's IT team

Aisha — if you can confirm the Platform Lead's email (for eventual handover) and the KMS account number, we will finalize the manifest today.

Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Desai <aisha.desai@meridianlabs.com>, Meridian Labs IT <it@meridianlabs.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-20T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Action: seed manifest + KMS examples attached

Hi Aisha / Rahul,

Attached are the two files Monica referenced: meridian-onboard-schedule.xlsx (timeline + invite window) and redwood-api-keying-checklist.pdf (seed manifest template is the first tab in the spreadsheet). I've also included a short example KMS URI and alias format in the spreadsheet.

Quick notes:
- I created a read-only test key named meridian-qa-readonly (expires in 14 days) and a test service-account token svc-meridian-qa. Please treat both as temporary and notify us if you require a different rotation policy.
- Seed manifest (tab: "manifest"): user-email, role, env (dev/stage/prod), key-scope. Please review and add the Platform Lead for handover.

Attachments: meridian-onboard-schedule.xlsx | redwood-api-keying-checklist.pdf

If everything looks good we'll run the invite + seed sprint on Tuesday at 10:00 PT. Otherwise propose an alternate time.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Onboarding Engineer
Redwood Inference
